Day/Boarding application policy:

Post interview we will select those students we wish to take to the next stage. Selected applicants will then need to register with us online( fee waivered as above) and then move to sit our school assessments, reference and school report to be included.
All spaces will be boarding.

I have completed the Online Vacancies Form.  In summary, for 2022 entry we have spaces in Year 12 for boys and girls.  For Year 9 boys and girls, the registration deadline is Monday 8th November.  Currently there are no spaces for Year 10 boys but we can add interested students to our Continued Interest List in case a space becomes available.  Year 10 is not an entry point for girls.

Day/Boarding application policy

Day applications:
Main entry points are Year 3, Year 7, Year 9 and Year 12.  We may occasionally have places 
 in other year groups, please contact us to confirm availability before applying.

Boarding applications:
Boarding at Freemen's is available from Year 9.  Main entry points are Year 9 and Year 12.  We do occasionally have places available in Year 10, please contact us to check availability beore applying.

Entrance assessments for entry to all year groups will comprise written examinations in Mathematics, English and Non-Verbal Reasoning, an individual interview and a report from the pupil's current school. 

Candidates applying for entry to the Sixth Form (16+) who are taking 8 or more I/GCSEs will not need to sit further entrance examinations.  Please note that we require English as a First Language at GCSE for entry to the Sixth Form.  Candidates who are taking English as a Second Language at GCSE will be required to sit a written English examination to demonstrate their command of the English language.
